notes: NOTE for 4.1.5 users: the in-app download can stick at 0% on 4.1.5 — if it does, tap Cancel and install the APK file sent in chat, it updates the same app. IMPORTANT: the new music backend is NOT live yet — the Worker at backendUrl still has to be deployed from the Cloudflare dashboard (steps in the project's backend/README.md). Until it is live, the app falls back to resolving songs on the phone (slow) and says so in Settings → Music Backend. WHAT'S NEW IN 4.1.8: (1) MUSIC BACKEND — songs, videos and lyrics now come from a BeatBox server (Cloudflare Worker) instead of heavy fetching on the phone: one small request returns a ready-to-play full song, so songs should stop staying 'Preview Only · 30s' on a slow connection. Search, full-song audio, video streams and synced lyrics all go through it first; the phone-side path is only a fallback. (2) VIDEO ACTUALLY RENDERS — the official thumbnail shows as the poster from the first frame, 'Buffering video…' stays up until the first frame really renders, and if the clock runs but no picture appears in 6 seconds the app drops to a lighter stream, then the YouTube player, and says so on screen. (3) SCREEN-OFF PLAYBACK — turning the screen off no longer stops the song: the foreground service takes over (same as swipe-away), with lock-screen controls. Settings → Permissions → Battery optimisation must be allowed, or some phones still stop the music. (4) TAP MOTION EVERYWHERE — every button, card, chip and row now visibly scales down and brightens on press with a spring-back. (5) PLAYER BUTTONS FIXED — play/pause, next/prev, shuffle and repeat audited: prev now seeks to the start in video mode too, a dead play tap in video mode falls back to audio, and shuffle/repeat ON states glow. (6) REFRESH ALL DATA — new button in Settings → Storage that clears every cached result and reloads the home fresh. (7) MORE OPTIMISATION — smooth scrolling, off-screen lists skip rendering, lyrics overlay no longer blurs the whole screen, progress updates once per second instead of 4x. (8) Video service takeover now hands over the AUDIO stream (was silent video-only), and the service hands the position back so playback resumes from the same second.
